title: Crime scene investigation – B1+ English Listening Test

seo.title: Crime scene investigation – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Boost your English with our engaging english listening test on crime scene investigation. Listen, answer and expand your vocabulary!

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Listen to a radio interview with a forensic scientist. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.
See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: What happened in the case Dr. Carter described?

choices.html: Someone wanted to rob and kill the victim.
The perpetrator tried to rob the victim but failed.
The perpetrator didn't try to rob the victim.

questions.prompt: What did the killer do on the night of the murder?

choices.html: He only took worthless items.
He pretended to be a burglar.
He didn't find any valuable items.

questions.prompt: What did they do during the investigation?

choices.html: They started by eliminating possible suspects.
They conducted DNA tests on everyone close to the victim.
They tried to find witnesses in the neighbourhood.

questions.prompt: What led the investigators to think the suspect was a hired hitman?

choices.html: Security cameras.
The autopsy.
Phone records.
The victim's wife's phone records.
The security cameras in the neighborhood.
Fingerprints found in the house.
The killer and the victim's wife were sentenced to 25 years in prison.
The killer will spend the rest of his life in prison.
The wife's sentence was reduced because of a lack of evidence.
He didn't steal anything.
He used a gun.
He parked his car in front of the house.
